facts.fact: Liberia's House of Representatives referred on 15 October 2026 to a joint committee, for ratification review within two weeks, a US$52 million build-operate-transfer concession with OeSD International GMBH for the National Identification Central Digital Civil Registry and Vital Statistics System, a central database of demographic and biometric records of up to 10 million people (Women Voices Newspaper, citing the House Press Bureau).
